title: Scoped obstruction: pivot 440 needs four restored donor windows (no new kappa)
body:
**Scoped negative result with an algebraic attaining control; no new κ.**

This resolves one bounded part of PR1337's window-donor handoff. On the pinned PR1297 base word, deleting pivot 440's three early B reads cannot be repaired by at most three restored donor windows, even with arbitrary rational or complex coefficients. Each window spans at most four consecutive source reads inside a no-write segment; helper readers are included. Four explicit windows restore the scalar map on all 704 arbitrary input columns. Their eight added ADD macros are an algebraic control; no physical frame, paid-moment or supplier improvement is claimed.

The package enumerates 2,758 windows (one zero), 1,611 projective directions and all relevant spans. The separate forward-pulse/integer-rank checker covers 5,177,758 cases. Exact proof, receipts, sources, failure controls, costs, scope and open questions are in `research/complex-p440-window-shocks/`.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and no dependencies:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-p440-window-shocks
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/complex-p440-window-shocks outcome=negative-result`.

Validation passed: registered Python 3.12.13 replay; separate Python 3.14.6 isolated, optimized, read-only relocation; seven semantic/package test groups; Ruff; selected-record integrity. Full cold replay, physical admission, full repository tests, hosted CI and Lean are unrun.

Seed 34, complex-supplier track. The refreshed overlap scan covered all 791 open PRs and 148 discussions, with no warning; the closest result remains PR1337's narrower two-shock census. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1314#discussioncomment-18912079
